name: gap_fill_stall_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, overnight gap-downs exceeding 1.2% reflect FII-driven or macro-driven price dislocation. During the first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30), algorithmic market makers and liquidity providers absorb order flow and establish the opening range. When NIFTY subsequently dips below the OR low within a single 5-second bar — triggering resting stop-loss orders and programmatic short entries — but fails to sustain below it (close recovers back above OR low in the same bar), the short-side flow is exhausted and absorbed. VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers, who are already tracking a benchmark significantly above current price, step in aggressively to exploit the dip, driving a reversal toward session VWAP.
core_signal_oneliner: Large gap day (>1.2%): opening-range fake breakdown — single 5s bar wicks below OR low then closes back above it with volume surge and no strong trend
